name: Paracetamol (Acetaminophen)
uses: Temporary relief of mild to moderate pain (headache, muscle ache, toothache) and reduction of fever.
common_side_effects: Liver toxicity (if taken in excess of recommended limit)
precautions: Do NOT exceed 4,000 mg (4g) in a 24-hour period.
Avoid alcohol while taking paracetamol to protect liver function.
Check ingredients of cold & flu combinations to prevent double dosing.
interactions: Warfarin (long-term heavy use may increase bleeding risk), alcohol, other acetaminophen-containing medications.
dosage_warning: Consult a physician or pharmacist for proper individual dosage based on age, weight, and health condition.

name: Ibuprofen
uses: Relief of pain, reduction of inflammation, and management of fever, arthritis, and menstrual cramps.
precautions: Take with food or milk to minimize stomach irritation.
Avoid if you have a history of stomach ulcers, severe heart failure, or kidney disease.
Do NOT take during the third trimester of pregnancy unless prescribed by a doctor.
interactions: Aspirin, blood thinners (warfarin), antihypertensives, ACE inhibitors, corticosteroids.
dosage_warning: Consult a healthcare professional for age and weight appropriate dosing instructions.

name: Amoxicillin
uses: Treatment of specific bacterial infections such as ear infections, pneumonia, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections.
precautions: Requires a valid prescription from a licensed healthcare provider.
Inform doctor immediately if you have a known penicillin allergy.
Complete the entire prescribed course even if symptoms improve early.
interactions: Oral contraceptives (may reduce efficacy), probenecid, allopurinol.
dosage_warning: Prescription medication only. Dosage must be strictly prescribed by a doctor.

name: Cetirizine
uses: Relief of allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, watery eyes, hives, and itchy skin.
precautions: Use caution when driving or operating machinery until you know how cetirizine affects you.
Avoid excessive alcohol consumption while taking antihistamines.
dosage_warning: Follow product package insert or consult a healthcare provider.

name: Omeprazole
uses: Treatment of acid reflux, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), heart burn, and stomach ulcers.
precautions: Usually taken before a meal (typically breakfast).
Long-term use should be monitored by a doctor due to potential vitamin B12 or magnesium deficiency.
interactions: Clopidogrel, antiretroviral drugs, digoxin, iron supplements.
dosage_warning: Consult a physician or pharmacist for medical advice on proper usage duration.

name: Metformin
uses: Management of type 2 diabetes mellitus to improve blood glucose control.
common_side_effects: Stomach cramps and loss of appetite
precautions: Take with meals to reduce stomach upset.
Avoid excessive alcohol consumption to prevent lactic acidosis.
interactions: Corticosteroids, diuretics, contrast agents used in imaging procedures.
dosage_warning: Prescription drug. Must be taken under strict medical supervision.

name: Aspirin (Acetylsalicylic Acid)
uses: Pain relief, anti-inflammatory, and low-dose prevention of cardiovascular events under medical supervision.
precautions: Do NOT give aspirin to children or teenagers recovering from viral infections due to Reye's syndrome risk.
Avoid taking on an empty stomach.
interactions: Other NSAIDs, blood thinners, alcohol, SSRIs.
dosage_warning: Do not self-prescribe aspirin for heart conditions without consulting a cardiologist.
